**v1.14.5: after Wizard101's November patch the bot reads your cards from the game's memory again, knows your health every round (so it drinks potions instead of walking from knockout to knockout), and learns look-alike cards such as Balanceblade and Bladestorm apart.**

- **Fixed: "the cards can't be read in this build" since Wizard101's patch (game build 6AFBB954-37B4000, around 2026-11-18).**
  - **What was wrong:** the bot finds the game's classes by their names in the game's code. After the patch, the name the card reader needs ("CombatPlanningPhaseWindow") sits right after two other bytes instead of on its own, and the bot skipped it. Every start then failed to build the card reader (vision\vision.log said so; debug.log didn't): your hand, your pips, the backpack, the decks, the gear and the game's UI size went unread, and battles fell back to finding cards by their pictures - right after a reinstall, with no cards learned yet, the bot passed every round.
  - **Now:** when a name isn't found on its own, the bot also accepts a copy that the game's code really loads. Every class it found before is found exactly as before.
- **Fixed: your health was never read when your name plate isn't found by its picture (UI scale 0.856 - 1920 wide), so no potions and a knockout loop.**
  - **What was wrong:** the game's memory had your health every round, but the bot only asked for it when your plate was found on screen. So the potion check never learned your most health, counted you at 100% and never drank, and after a knockout the bot walked straight into the next battle (5 knockouts in 9 minutes on 2026-11-21).
  - **Now:** your health is read every round, from the game's memory first and your plate when it's found; the enemy-danger check uses it too. After a drink that took, the bot drinks again (3 at most) while still under your potion limit, stopping if you start playing, a battle starts or the bot is turned off. A health globe it can't read just after a knockout counts as 1 health. Heals and Tower Shield still need your plate (they click it), and a party healer no longer holds an ally's heal for one of yours that can't go.
- **Fixed: look-alike cards (Balanceblade and Bladestorm) learned as one.**
  - **What was wrong:** the two blades' pictures are mostly the same white disc, so a Bladestorm was taken for a copy of the Balanceblade beside it and never learned; from then on every Bladestorm was named Balanceblade and its blade often went uncast.
  - **Now:** while the game's hand is read, a copy is told by the game's card names. A box whose picture names another card, where the game has its own card, is learned as the card it is (once - no duplicate of a card already learned).
- **Also:** starting the bot while a full-screen Wizard101 is minimized no longer picks the wrong picture size (a minimized window read as 160x28); when the window comes back at a size it was played at before (generated\scales.txt), that size's pictures are used.
- **Checked:** against the running game (reading only): the card reader builds again and every other class reads as before; the bot played from the game's memory from 08:13 on 2026-11-21. Each fix has its own new test file (each fails on the old code), and each went through a review with skeptics until nothing was left (the confirmed findings fixed). The five release scripts load. 880 of 919 vision tests pass (38 are skipped on this PC). `test_ahk_names`' speedhack path test errors, as on v1.12.0. The health and look-alike fixes are not tried in a battle yet.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install. Your settings, learned cards, routes and recorded battles are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
